children: Control Empresarial De Capitales S.A. De C.V., identified as a 10% Owner, reported direct sales of Class A common shares on September 2, 2026. The transactions were completed at weighted average prices of $76.9442 and $77.0861 per share. The total sale amount reported was $7,702,151. Following the sales, the reporter directly owned 14,185,397 Class A common shares. Exhibit 99.1 is incorporated by reference as noted in the filing.
